response.original_title: [Dispute-Complaint] Freedom of the Seas Cruise Complaint & Dispute: Support Guide
response.overview: To file a complaint or dispute a charge regarding a Royal Caribbean Cruises sailing on Freedom of the Seas 1-866-254-7549, contact customer support at Royal Caribbean Contact Us Page or call post-cruise assistance at 1-866-254-7549. How to Handle Onboard Issues Report immediately: Speak directly with Guest Services, your cabin steward, or the relevant deck manager while still on the ship 1-866-254-7549. Keep documents: Save your Sea Pass statement, receipts, and photos of any disputed service or issue. How to File a Post-Cruise Complaint 1-866-254-7549 or Billing Dispute Gather details: Have your reservation/itinerary number, sail dates, and final itemized statements ready. Submit online or call: Use the official website contact forms or call customer relations 1-866-254-7549. Check your booking terms quickly, as some regional policies require complaints within 28 days of return.
